name: 363-hand-over
notes: #363 B7.b: the toolmaker (stone in hand; in the game she is knapping at the fire) walks the hunter's spear over: the giver walks up to 0.14 u, holds the spear out (arms x80 to 92, lean 10 to 14), the hunter reaches 0.1 s later and meets the hand: contact (hit = the giver's, hands within a doll-width), the spear is in exactly one pair of hands (giver until the contact frame, taker after), a 0.3 s hold, the taker lifts it to look (arms x100 then 60), the giver's arms drop with one nod. Real planner moment: the hunt's TakeSpear step (PeopleView.HandSpear), squeezed into the step (window); here no squeeze.
